attributes.board_name: Texas Board of Occupational Therapy Examiners (Executive Council of Physical Therapy & Occupational Therapy Examiners)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities approved or offered by AOTA or TOTA are pre-approved; other activities must meet 40 TAC §367.2 (Other Acceptable Activities). No requirement to use Board-pre-approved courses except the HHSC human trafficking course.
rules.audit_note: CE is entered on the CE Submission Form in the online renewal portal (or paper form). Audits under 40 TAC §367.3; keep documentation 4 years from the end of the expiration month of the renewal period.

topics.who: HHSC-approved human trafficking prevention course each renewal period (required since 9/1/2020); up to 2 hours count toward the 24; AOTA/TOTA courses count only if also HHSC-approved
Pass the Board's online jurisprudence exam (JP) as part of each renewal

rules.legal_basis: 40 Tex. Admin. Code ch. 367 (§§367.1–367.3, amended eff. June 1, 2024); §370.1; Tex. Occ. Code ch. 454
rules.notes: Licenses renew every two years by the end of the birth month (§370.1(a)). 24 contact hours required since 9/1/2019.
